A '''hammer-dulcimer''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument that could be operated by a single pair of limbs. [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] used a miniature, amplified hammer-dulcimer as part of his one-being orchestra during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
